acceptance.1_boundary: main.py _template_search_context reads the persona only for tenant and persona identity; the symbol boundary is governed_market_dataset.build_market_boundary + dataset_for (via _load_template_search_governed_dataset). market_scope and traits.instruments are not read. test_real_persona_reconcile_entry_drives_compilation_and_real_backtest_gate runs the real run entry (HttpPoolCyclePorts -> research route -> worker thread) with the recorded hosted persona shape (marketScope {} and traits.instruments [0050.TWSE]) and a daily_bars store written from recorded TWSE bars; it reaches the real gate (receipt real_backtest_validation status survivorship_limited, dataset_id gmd-...).
acceptance.2_compile: services/source_ingestion/hypothesis_compiler.py now exposes attach_default_market_screen and DEFAULT_SCREEN_ID; _pair_defaults calls it (test_hypothesis_compiler*.py unchanged and passing) and compile_template calls the same function, so the whole_governed_tw_boundary.v1 screen (min_size, history, liquidity window, median traded value, eligibility) is shared, not copied. The template signal, parameters and controls are unchanged (test_compiler_preserves_every_registered_time_series_signal_on_recorded_inputs unchanged, over 100 templates) and validate_strategy_artifact passes (test_compiled_artifact_carries_the_shared_default_screen_and_the_unchanged_signal). The screen needs candidate_pool_market.v1: template_demand_search.market_from_dataset builds it from the dataset's own bars with includes_delisted and includes_suspended false (no survivorship claim is made). A market the dataset owner supplies with its own attestation is used as supplied.
acceptance.3_inputs: usable_symbols/inputs_available judge a template by the fields present over the eligible boundary; a symbol with a missing or non-finite field is excluded with its reason (field_incomplete:<field>, no_bars) and the rest are evaluated; nothing is imputed; a template whose input dataset is not served stays excluded with template_inputs_missing. Receipts record boundary_symbols and symbols_without_inputs. Tests: test_partial_boundary_evaluates_on_complete_symbols_and_names_the_rest_without_imputation, test_missing_universe_fields_and_vwap_are_excluded_without_imputation.
acceptance.4_reevaluation: A template with a recorded attempt in the demand is never evaluated again because a new daily snapshot changes the artifact id (template_demand_search._run, by template_id). Test test_a_new_daily_snapshot_never_reevaluates_a_template_and_the_trial_count_rises_once evaluates two templates, switches to a second snapshot id and shows attempts and family trial counts unchanged. One screened evaluation spends two family trials in the gate (screen variant + entry variant, replication/gate.py trial_accounting), not one; this is the gate's existing rule (thresholds and counters unchanged) and is why three assertions changed (see changed_assertions).

5_budgets_and_cost.thresholds_budgets: FAMILY_TRIAL_BUDGET 500, RUN_BUDGET 50 and the worker's run_budget=1 are unchanged; gate thresholds unchanged.
5_budgets_and_cost.templates_per_demand_life: run budget 1 new template per run; at most one run per demand per persona cycle; a demand lives 30 days: with the daily cycle at most about 30 templates per demand life (171 registered time-series templates; the family budget 500 allows 250 screened evaluations per family).
5_budgets_and_cost.measured_one_template: Measured here, one template (KMID) through the real gate and screened backtest with a test-only attested market, 2 symbols (2330, 0050) x 1,361 bars (about 680 trading days each), one process, 12 vCPU dev VM, Python 3.12: wall 502.7 s, peak RSS 401 MiB (118 MiB before). It is the registry's per-trading-day screen replay (services/registry/candidate_pool.py evaluate_screened_views, called per day by vectorbt_adapter._screened_artifact_view_sequence) plus the whole-boundary control backtest; both scale with symbols x days.
5_budgets_and_cost.whole_market_not_measured: A 60 symbol boundary (MAX_DATASET_SYMBOLS) was NOT measured; by linear scaling in symbols it would be about 4 hours and well over 512 MiB, which does not fit a single run in research-orchestrator-svc (384m) or alpha-replication-worker (512m). This is stated as an open limit, not claimed to fit: either the screen replay is made incremental (services/registry/candidate_pool.py recomputes features from the full history for every day) or the boundary used per template is bounded, and the limit needed must be measured at 60 symbols. The work runs in the run's retrain-executor worker thread, never on an API event loop (governed_market_dataset raises governed_dataset_must_run_in_worker on a running loop).
5_budgets_and_cost.recommendation_for_operator: Before enabling hosted whole-market evaluation, measure peak RSS and wall time at 60 symbols in the worker that runs it; the first hosted results will be the refusals above, which cost about 0.1 s.

acceptance.6_end_states: Every end state is on the demand and the run: search_completed, run_budget_exhausted, or template_search_unavailable:<exception>:<detail> (for example market_boundary_empty, daily_bars_store_stale, survivorship_limited receipts). test_failed_or_partial_runs_record_a_reason_and_never_satisfy_the_demand covers run_budget_exhausted and a failed run; the demand stays open and satisfied_by is empty. The end of test_open_demand_reconcile_template_search_gate_registration_and_pool_cycle_admit_trial shows a refused outcome leaves the demand open.
acceptance.7_pool_unchanged: Pool admission code is untouched. ResearchDemandStore.record_pool_refusal and POST /api/research/persona-demands/{demand_id}/pool-refusal (same writer authentication as /actions) record a refusal such as candidate_outside_pool_approved_universe on the attempt (pool_admission) so it is visible on the demand; the demand is not satisfied by it. Tests: test_pool_refusal_is_recorded_on_the_attempt_and_visible_on_the_demand, test_pool_refusal_route_records_for_the_writer_and_refuses_unknown_attempts. The persona pool cycle does not call this route yet (services/control-plane/persona and services/persona are outside this task's artifacts): a follow-up must call it when it refuses a template candidate. Registration and approval of a passing candidate keep their owner path and stay paper only.
acceptance.8_runtime_budget: docs/operations/storage-manifest.json runtime_budgets gains research_demands.json: about 17 KB per recorded attempt (measured 16,960 B), at most 171 attempts per demand (2.9 MB), 30 day demand life, the excluded list replaced per run; new cleanup: a closed demand drops gate and artifact bodies of its attempts 60 days after expires_at (research_demand.CLOSED_COMPACT_AFTER, test_closed_demand_attempts_are_compacted_after_the_retention_and_keep_their_receipts). scripts/check_storage_manifest.py passes.
